references.text: Detailed regulations for grain offerings and drink offerings to accompany the burnt offering, including quantities for bulls, rams, and lambs.
Earlier instructions regarding grain offerings and drink offerings that were to accompany the daily sacrifices.
Parallel wording concerning grain offerings and drink offerings for the bull, the ram, and the lambs according to the regulation, used earlier in the same chapter about the Feast of Tabernacles.
Repeated wording about grain offerings and drink offerings according to the regulation for the second day of the Feast of Tabernacles.
The same pattern with grain offerings and drink offerings according to the number and regulation for the third day.
Identical wording for the fourth day of the Feast of Tabernacles.
The same regulation concerning grain offerings and drink offerings for the fifth day.
Parallel text for the sixth day of the Feast of Tabernacles.
The eighth day of the Feast of Tabernacles was to be a holy assembly with a fire offering to the Lord, as described in Num 29:37.
